messages:
maya: Heads-up: PR ready — console observability cleanup. Replaced the old dashboard sample with a pagination-friendly layout and updated the SDK snippets (JS + Python). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/842

sam: Nice. Is this the latency/cost breakdown panel we talked about last week?

maya: Yep — dynamic breakdown by route/model. Also found the tracing hook example used an outdated field (trace_id) — switched to trace.trace_id across examples.

jon: I can review the SDK snippets. Current docs use `redwood.console.getDashboard(...)` which is stale. Proposing new JS usage.

jon: Proposed JS snippet:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const panel = await client.console.getPanel('latency-breakdown');
console.log(panel.breakdown);
```

lia: Also FYI the dashboard JSON had `panel.v1` instead of a `panels` array — that broke preview rendering on staging. I pushed a tiny fix mapping it to panels.

maya: Thanks @lia — can you paste the commit sha?

lia: sha: 7a3b2f1 — changed panel.v1 -> panels and added a schema_version comment.

docs-bot: Auto-check: linkcheck failed on https://docs.redwood.ai/console/observability#cost-breakdown — returned 404. Flagged in the PR.

sam: @maya can we add a short migration note for Dedicated customers? Their reserved metric keys differ (reserved.* -> reserved_capacity.*).

maya: Good catch — I'll add a Migration > Dedicated note under Console -> Metrics and include a code diff.

jon: I'll do a wording pass on the JS and Python snippets and approve after that. @sam any acceptance criteria for SLO owners to validate?

sam: SLO owners should verify latency bucket names and check custom routing keys. If they use custom keys we should call out mapping in the migration section.

maya: :thumbsup: Aiming to merge by EOD. Can folks do a quick review?

jon: :eyes: I'll finish in ~30m.

lia: :white_check_mark: Dashboard preview rendering fixed on staging.

docs-bot: PR merged by maya — deployment to staging triggered. Release job: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/5123
